title: Interactive wand prices
detail: 2nd-gen wands light up and vibrate on a successful spell. 1st-gen still sold at $65. Engraving $30 (11 letters max, letters only, same-day purchase). Three 2nd-gen wands = about $255 pre-tax.
tip: Whether non-interactive wands are still sold is unclear (sources conflict).

title: Where to buy wands
detail: Ollivanders (Diagon Alley and Hogsmeade), Wands by Gregorovitch (Diagon), Hogsmeade wand cart near the castle, Cosme Acajor Baguettes Magique at Epic (10 Epic-exclusive designs), CityWalk.

title: Lord Voldemort 2nd-gen wand
detail: Released April 2026; promoted with the 2026 Dark Arts season.

title: Universal Play wand app
detail: Scan the wand's barcode in the Universal Orlando app to create a wizard profile (name, avatar, Patronus, house), track spells and earn house points; House Cup awarded daily.
tip: Link each kid's wand to their own profile before the trip.

title: Hogsmeade spell spots
detail: 11 spell spots. 2nd-gen-only: Duelling Club Tent and The Owl Post.

title: Diagon Alley spell spots
detail: 12 spell spots plus 1 hidden spell at Slug & Jiggers Apothecary.

title: Knockturn Alley spell spots
detail: 7 spell spots. 2nd-gen-only: Knockturn Alley Staircase (Patronus), Ariadne's Spinners, Knockturn Alley Sky.
tip: Some mapped spots only show on the map under the alley's black light.

title: Ministry of Magic spell spots
detail: 12 spell spots. Stand on the medallion, face the direction it points, trace the spell shape and say the incantation.
tip: Unverified whether 1st-gen wands work at Epic spell spots.

title: Ollivanders wand choosing show
detail: Free, about 5 minutes; one guest is chosen to have a wand pick them. Diagon Alley location has two show rooms.
tip: Diagon Alley's two rooms move faster; go early morning or late in the day.

title: Ollivanders wand choosing show
detail: Free, about 5 minutes; one guest is chosen.
tip: Lines are long midday; go early or late.

title: Power-Up Band
detail: RFID wristband linked to the Universal app (scan QR). 8 designs: Mario, Luigi, Peach, Daisy, Toad, Yoshi, Donkey Kong, Diddy Kong (DK and Diddy Epic-exclusive). Works as an amiibo. Hit ? blocks for coins, earn stamps (15-300 coins each), tap the 'M' on Mario Kart wheels, break barrels/drums/letters in DK Country, earn keys.
tip: One band per kid so each earns their own keys and score; at least one band per party needed for Bowser Jr.

title: Key Challenge: Goomba Crazy Crank
detail: Crank fast enough to make the ground spin and knock the Goomba off. Location: left of Peach's Castle, in front of the Piranha Plant deck.

title: Key Challenge: Koopa Troopa POWer Punch
detail: Time the POW Block hits to launch a shell up the pipe. Location: right of Goomba Crazy Crank.

title: Key Challenge: Piranha Plant Nap Mishap
detail: Run back and forth tapping alarm clocks to put the giant Piranha Plant back to sleep. Location: wooden deck in front of Peach's Castle.

title: Key Challenge: Bob-omb Kaboom Room
detail: Gather key fragments around the room and assemble them on the wall before the Bob-omb explodes. Location: end of an underground maze after a shrinking passageway.

title: Key Challenge: Thwomp Panel Panic
detail: Flip every wall tile to the same color before the Thwomp slams. Location: room marked with a Thwomp.

title: Bowser Jr. Shadow Showdown
detail: Unlocked with 3 of 5 keys. Final battle where your projected shadow fights Bowser Jr. to recover the Golden Mushroom. Up to 12 players at once. Ages 5+. Location: tower left of Peach's Castle.
tip: Collect keys early; leaderboard rankings tracked in app.

land: Super Nintendo World - Donkey Kong Country
title: DK Country band interactives
detail: Breakable barrels, drums and hidden letters that react to a Power-Up Band.

title: Fyre Drill
detail: Dragon-headed boats with water cannons aimed at 130+ moving flame targets; guests on land can shoot at boats and riders shoot back.

title: Dragon Racer's Rally
detail: Riders control the wings to adjust intensity from mild to wild; up to 67 ft high.

title: Viking Training Camp
detail: Climbing towers, agility course, Viking drums and chimes, sheep launcher game, Toothless teeter-totter, slides, Toothless viewfinders for dragon spotting.

title: Baby dragon show
detail: Walk-up ~10-minute show with a handler and robotic baby dragons near Toothless's paddock gate; photo at the end.
tip: Not on posted schedules (unverified for 2026); check the app.

title: Interactive shoulder dragons
detail: Electronic shoulder-dragon toys described pre-opening as interacting with the land (unverified; no price found).

title: Constellation Carousel
detail: Each celestial creature can rotate 360 degrees and rise 6 ft; 7 songs, each with its own maneuvers; bench option available.

title: Astronomica splash pad
detail: Compass-rose splash pad with fountains synced to music; bronze medallions point to each world.

title: Darkmoor Monster Makeup Experience
detail: Creature makeup salon: 'The Experiment' or full costume treatment; temporary tattoos also offered.
cost: ~$45 (The Experiment); ~$169 adult / $109 child (full) - per Frommer's, may have changed

title: Villain-Con Minion Blast
detail: Standing moving-walkway blaster game; hit boxes to earn Freeze Ray, Banana Bomb or Explosive Nunchuck power-ups. No Express Pass.
tip: Sign into the Universal app before boarding to sync your blaster; aim at gold-bordered collectibles and physical set pieces others ignore.

title: King Harold's Swamp Symphony
detail: Interactive lily pads that trigger frog sounds.

title: Mama Luna Feline Fiesta
detail: Interactive screen-based cat play (Puss in Boots).

title: Shrek's Swamp for Little Ogres
detail: Play zone with slides, wet areas and climbing.

title: Po's Kung Fu Training Camp
detail: Wet and dry play with water cannons, dump buckets, giant fans.

title: Poppy's Playground
detail: Shaded bouncing and climbing play area (Trolls).

title: Po Live!
detail: CLOSED for refurbishment, no reopening date.

title: Camp Jurassic water spitters
detail: Two water-battle zones: lower level has 4 Dilophosaurus spitters with protective crests (limited aim); upper level guns aim in every direction but have no shields.
tip: Upper vs lower level makes a good twins-vs-sister battle.

title: Camp Jurassic play area
detail: Caves, amber mines, capture nets, swaying rope bridges, ground-rumble/roar effects, Echo Cavern, geyser cavern.
tip: Go early when fog covers the ground; wear grippy shoes.

title: Caro-Seuss-el
detail: Pull the reins or levers to make your creature move.

title: One Fish, Two Fish, Red Fish, Blue Fish
detail: Control your fish's height; follow the song lyrics to avoid water squirts.
tip: Listen to the song or get wet.

title: If I Ran the Zoo
detail: Play area with tube slides, caves and water play.

title: Gringotts Money Exchange
detail: Exchange US dollars for wizarding bank notes ($10/$20) spendable around the resort.

title: Owl Post mail
detail: Mail letters/postcards with an official Hogsmeade postmark; bring or buy stationery and postage.

title: Hogwarts Express
detail: Travels between King's Cross (USF) and Hogsmeade Station (IOA); different show in each direction.
